body: PROPOSED SHAPE: a dedicated non-case WeightedCoverage (name negotiable), not MassRatio composition: final class WeightedCoverage private (val estimate: ScoreEstimate, val conditioningWeight: Double, val coverage: Coverage). The support accessor is coverage.fraction; conditioningWeight renders separately and is never divided by eligible count. Construction from numerator + observed weights + eligible count validates finite nonnegative weights/outcomes and Coverage, then distinguishes three states: zero observed leaves -> Missing(AllMissing), observed leaves but zero total weight -> Missing(Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight)), positive weight -> Observed(numerator/conditioningWeight). This also exposes a current conflation: wsum <= 0 labels observed all-zero weights as AllMissing. RecallSignature changes its field to this carrier; SignatureProjection consumes estimate.toOption, takes coverage.fraction into weakest support, and no longer lists importance as unsupported; codecs/reports carry both conditioningWeight and the two counts. Required discriminator through RecallSignature.compute: same eligible leaves, same wsum, same numeric value, but one heavy observed leaf versus two light observed leaves; only coverage may differ. Separate zero-observed and observed-zero-weight tests, plus mutation that replaces observed count with eligible. Make it a private-constructor non-case class with checked construction so the four-way relation cannot be forged. This is a public vocabulary addition and needs your explicit approval/ADR line before implementation. No edit or reservation.
